app_subtitle: Tiny 2: live view, camera controls and recording.
update_interval_help: A check always runs at startup. This interval controls additional checks while running; a month is 30 days.
update_url: GitHub JSON address for version checking (optional)
source_url: GitHub base address for language packs (optional)
no_source: Please enter the GitHub address first.
repository_placeholder: Please replace xxxx in the GitHub address with the repository name.
network_error: The GitHub request failed. Please check the address and internet connection.
pack_error: The language pack is invalid, incomplete, intended for a different application, or already installed. Existing languages are preserved.
write_error: The settings could not be saved.
new_version: New version available: {version}. Nothing is installed automatically.
installed: Language and help installed. Save settings to apply.
help_error: Local help could not be opened.
license_notice: This application comes WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY.
profile_name_error: Please enter a unique profile name with 1 to 100 characters.
profiles_error: The profiles could not be loaded. The existing file is preserved.
file_dialog_error: The initial folder could not be opened.
protected_target: This file belongs to the application data and cannot be overwritten by an export. Please choose another location.
job_error: The operation failed. Further information is in the log.
waiting_close: The running operation is finishing. The application will then close.
demo_file_text: Test file from the Python base template.
log_readonly: The log is read-only. Export saves a separate copy.
log_error: The log could not be read.
cannot_cancel: This operation cannot be safely cancelled.
export_empty: There are no results to export.
software_unconfigured: Update checking is not configured yet
software_check_failed: Software status could not be checked
update_error: Version checking failed. The software status is unknown.
update_download_error: The update could not be downloaded and verified completely. Existing files are retained.
ticket_intro: Fictional tip workshop: create tips and save them locally. No ticket is submitted or purchased.
single_desc: Choose six numbers yourself or generate random quick picks.
system_desc: Set fixed bank numbers, choose additional numbers, and create all matching six-number combinations.
share_desc: Record known six-number combinations from a share ticket and your own share.
champion_desc: Build a custom full system with fixed and chosen numbers.
draw_deadline_unknown: No regular cutoff is listed here for this weekday.
changing_quick_help: New quick numbers are generated for each later draw entered. Manual tips stay the same.
ticket_dates_note: The subscription is a local ticket note. Enter draw dates above. Quick and manual combinations stay unique within each draw.
single_help: Set the maximum in Program Settings. Select numbers in the five-column grid; after six numbers, the next row opens automatically. Quick fills a row at random, and the trash icon clears it.
single_six_limit: A single tip contains exactly six numbers.
single_complete_rows: Complete every tip row with exactly six numbers or use its Quick button.
select_tip_numbers: Select numbers for this tip row
current_cost_empty: Current price: no complete tips yet · €1.50 per Lotto tip and round; optional LottoPlus adds €0.80 per tip and round (two LottoPlus draws, excluding Joker).
lottoplus_help: For the price display: adds €0.80 per tip and round. One tip qualifies for two LottoPlus draws. Saved locally; no participation takes place.
single_limit_reached: The configured limit of {max} single tips has been reached.
duplicate_tip: This six-number combination already exists as a quick or manual tip.
system_help: Choose a system on the left. The first number is the required bank count, the second the choice count. Complete both groups manually or use random selection. The number of single tips and the price appear on the right.
system_combination_summary: {total} numbers selected · Full system: {count} six-number tips
system_bank_limit: You can select at most six bank numbers.
champion_help: Choose fixed bank numbers and additional chosen numbers. The full system creates all matching six-number combinations. Filters and guarantees are not included yet.
champion_combination_summary: Full system without filters: {count} six-number tips
confirm_delete_tip: Permanently delete this tip from the saved ticket?
confirm_delete_ticket: Permanently delete this ticket and all its saved tips?
discard_unsaved_tips: Discard the unsaved tips and switch game type?
system_random: Select random numbers for this group
system_fill_selection: Please complete the bank and choice numbers for the selected system.
champion_filters_planned: Planned – not available yet. Currently calculating the full system.
ticket_mode_removed: This game type was removed. Its saved data is preserved.
saved_ticket_note: Expand a ticket to view its data and individual tips. Deletion requires confirmation. Use the Games menu for new entries.
joker_invalid: Enter up to ten Joker numbers with exactly six digits each.
prices_not_verified: Prices not currently verified – check in Data archive.
history_inventory: {lotto} Lotto combinations · {joker} Joker numbers · {quotes} prize records ({verified} with official source)
history_gaps: Prize records and historical price periods may be incomplete. Missing or conflicting values are unknown. LottoPlus draw archive is not included yet.
history_missing: Archive database is missing or could not be read.
history_imported: Imported {count} new draws and supplemented existing prize records.
history_error: Archive/source verification failed. See the log for details.
history_date_error: Enter valid dates in DD.MM.YYYY format and select an existing ticket.
history_simulation: Historical comparison – no confirmed participation. Prices and payouts refer to each date; ATS and EUR are separate. ? means unknown.
history_results: {count} individual results; complete result stored in the ticket database.
history_truncated: Display limited to 2,000 rows. The complete result is stored.
history_note_quote_unknown: Prize is missing, conflicting or a jackpot; payout unknown.
history_note_quotes_missing: Prize data is missing; rank follows the historical rules.
history_note_price_unknown: Stake price for this date is unknown.
history_note_lottoplus_missing: LottoPlus draw and prize data is missing; total payout is unknown.
history_partial_warning: Partial amounts are not a complete balance.
history_note_draw_unverified: Draw is not evidenced by an official source; no reliable monetary comparison.
studio_subtitle: USB cameras · OBSBOT Tiny 2 and Logitech C922 Pro
no_camera: No supported USB camera connected – check cable and VM passthrough.
preview_alt: Live view of the selected camera
preview_empty:
No live view yet
Camera → Start live view
linux_hint: Linux: position values may show the last commanded target. Speed movement is unavailable. Active tracking may override manual moves.
tool_hint: Select a function and set its values. Then click Apply below or press Ctrl+Enter. Input values are targets, not readings from the camera.
tracking_conflict: AI tracking is active. Gimbal movement and position storage are disabled until tracking is turned off.
tracking_status_unknown: Reading tracking status. Gimbal movement and position storage stay disabled until the status is confirmed.
backend_unavailable: Loading camera controls. Open Diagnostics and Log if this fails.
preview_width: Preview width (640, 1280 or 1920 pixels; applies on next start)
preview_fps: Preview frame rate (Tiny 2 up to 30; C922 up to 60 fps at 720p)
camera_error: Camera command failed. Check connection, permissions and log.
choose_tool_page: First open Movement, Tracking, Image or Presets and choose a function.
preset_confirm: This command changes or deletes a preset stored on the camera. Continue?
one_camera_only: Integrated live view requires exactly one connected Tiny 2. Disconnect additional Tiny 2 cameras.
camera_missing: The selected camera is unavailable. Check connection and permissions.
video_failed: Live view unavailable. Camera busy, disconnected or unsupported format. Check connection and log; try 1280 × 720 at 30 frames/s.
record_failed: Recording could not be saved completely. Check the log; a partial file is retained for diagnosis.
preview_required: Start live view and wait for the first frame.
target_exists: Target file already exists. Choose another name; existing files are protected.
environment_readonly: Read-only check – no installation or system changes
optional_missing: Optional; missing. Integrated WebM recording does not require FFmpeg.
backend_missing: Camera server missing. Build the project first.
helper_missing: Linux camera helper missing. Build the project first.
hint_gimbal_move: Absolute target angles in degrees. Positive yaw: left; positive pitch: down.
hint_gimbal_recenter: Move the camera to yaw 0° and pitch 0°.
hint_zoom_uvc: Zoom on the UVC scale from 1 to 2. This is not an optical magnification factor.
hint_zoom_vendor: Vendor zoom scale with transition speed. Values may differ from UVC zoom.
hint_gimbal_position: On Linux this may report the last commanded target, not the confirmed physical position.
hint_aim_at_pixel: Use coordinates from a fresh, unmodified 16:9 camera frame. Disable tracking first. Dimensions must match the frame.
hint_zoom_to_fit: Specify a rectangle in a fresh 16:9 camera frame. Disable tracking first; dimensions and coordinates must match.
hint_ai_track: Choose a subject mode and framing. Tracking may override manual movement.
hint_focus_face: Enable or disable automatic face focus priority.
hint_image_fov: Choose Wide, Medium or Narrow, then click Apply below. The change is sent to the Tiny 2.
hint_image_hdr: Enable or disable high dynamic range.
hint_image_wb_auto: Let the camera adjust white balance.
hint_image_wb_manual: Color temperature in Kelvin. The server accounts for the device range.
hint_image_adjust: Brightness, contrast and other controls on a scale from 0 to 100.
hint_image_exposure_auto: Meter the full frame or prioritize a face.
hint_image_exposure_manual: Exposure level on a scale from 0 to 100.
hint_preset_list: Read occupancy, names and positions of the three camera preset slots.
hint_preset_save: Save the current position to an empty slot.
hint_preset_recall: Move to a stored camera position.
hint_preset_update: Replace an existing preset with the current position.
hint_preset_rename: Rename a stored preset. Use ASCII names up to 40 characters.
hint_preset_delete: Remove a stored preset from the camera.
mirror_horizontal_on: Mirroring enabled – applies to live view, photos and video.
audio_missing: No microphone belonging to the selected camera is available. Check USB connection.
audio_unavailable: Saved microphone unavailable – select another source.
audio_muted: The selected camera microphone is muted. Unmute it in system settings.
audio_record_failed: Separate audio recording failed. Check the microphone, encoder and log.
uvc_hint: All driver-reported settings are listed individually. Select one, change its target and select Controls → Apply. Values use the device scale. Disable the corresponding automatic mode before changing manual settings.
uvc_inactive: This setting is currently locked. Disable the corresponding automatic mode first; read-only values cannot be changed.
uvc_status: Camera detected. Choose its video format on the left; select Virtual camera to forward its image.
tiny_only: This function is only available for the OBSBOT Tiny 2.
unsupported_format: The camera does not offer this combination. Select an available combination under Video format.
uvc_exposure_dynamic: Dynamic frame rate in low light
choose_uvc_page: First open Camera settings and choose a control.
uvc_no_controls: No camera controls could be read. Check connection, permissions and log; live view and recording are separate.
wake_error: Waking could not be confirmed. Check USB connection and find cameras again; see the log.
awake_no_preview: Camera is awake. To see video: Camera → Start live view.
video_hint: Choose video format and recording options. MP4/H.264 uses bitrate to control quality; its separate quality slider is disabled.
format_hint: All pixel formats reported by the camera and supported by the app are available. Tiny automatically picks a compatible resolution and frame rate if needed. Changes restart the live view.
output_hint: WebM/MKV: VP8 + Opus; MP4: H.264 + AAC; AVI: JPEG + PCM. Only installed encoders are offered. Rotation, mirroring, grayscale and negative also apply to photos and videos. Start recording below on this page; start a photo series from Extras.
camera_profiles_heading: Save and restore settings for this camera
camera_profiles_hint: Enter a profile name to save. Select an existing profile and choose Load or Delete. Profiles include video format, recording options, mirroring, image filters and valid camera image controls. Profiles are camera-specific; Tiny pan/tilt and virtual-camera output are not stored.
profile_overwrite: Replace the camera profile with this name?
profile_error: Could not process the camera profile. Check its name, the connection and supported formats; details are in the log.
defaults_confirm: Reset this camera’s image controls to the defaults reported by its driver? Tiny pan and tilt are preserved.
sleeping_on_exit: Preview stopped; putting Tiny to sleep …
sleep_failed_exit: Could not confirm that Tiny is asleep. Quit anyway?
no_supported_format: The camera reports no supported video format.
encoder_missing: The required recording encoder is unavailable.
uvc_unreliable: This driver control is read-only: its current/default value cannot safely be restored, or Tiny 2 exposure requires the verified controls under Image & Focus.
virtual_explanation: Send the processed preview to a configured virtual camera. Other applications then select its camera device.
virtual_hint: Start and stop from Extras → Virtual camera. Requires a configured akvcam or v4l2loopback driver. This application does not install drivers. Only video is forwarded, without crosshair or watermark; select the camera microphone for audio separately in the receiving application. Stop forwarding before changing the camera, video format or filters.
virtual_missing: No virtual output device is available. A suitable driver must be configured first.
virtual_running: Virtual camera is receiving the processed image.
virtual_failed: Video forwarding failed. Check the output device, format and permissions; details are in the log.
virtual_active: First stop forwarding under Extras → Virtual camera.
virtual_loop: Use a physical camera as the forwarding source. Virtual sources are blocked to prevent feedback loops.
audio_format_hint: Available audio formats depend on the video container: Opus in WebM/MKV, AAC in MP4, PCM in AVI.
audio_file_format: File format for separate audio capture
audio_capture_hint: Audio is recorded independently from the camera image as a separate file. Choose the microphone, format and destination folder here.
audio_capture_active: Stop the separate audio recording first.
hint_voice_control: Select a command and enable or disable it, then Apply. Check recognition on the camera; a successful write does not verify the effect.
hint_voice_language: Select English or Chinese recognition, then Apply. This does not change the app language. Check recognition on the camera.
hint_gesture_control: Select a gesture and enable or disable it, then Apply. Check its effect on the camera; behavior depends on firmware.
speech_functions_hint: Select a function under Voice or Gestures and set its switch. Apply sends only the highlighted row. Inputs are saved. Please check the effect on the camera.
gesture_sign_target: Hold an open palm toward the camera. Repeat the gesture to start or stop tracking.
gesture_sign_zoom: Make an L with thumb and index finger; fold the other fingers. Repeat to reset the zoom.
gesture_sign_dynamic-zoom: Make an L with each hand. Once the camera responds, change the distance between your hands.
gesture_sign_mirror: Use the same two-hand gesture as dynamic zoom. This switch only reverses the zoom direction.
gesture_sign_note: Show your hands beside your face without covering it.
audio_record_incomplete: The audio recording could not be finalized. Its file is preserved for recovery: {path}
control_restore_failed: The previous automatic mode could not be restored after a camera error. Please check exposure/focus; technical details are in the log.
reset_all_settings_confirm: Reset all Tiny settings, including saved camera profiles and voice, gesture and camera-function values? Recordings and settings stored directly on the camera will be kept.
reset_settings_busy: Settings cannot be reset while recording or while the virtual camera is active.
settings_reset: All Tiny settings have been reset.
